-32.92326,151.7923: Near this site, between Nobbys (Whibayganba) and Fort Scratchley (Tahlbihn) Governor Lachlan Macquarie Esquire laid the foundation stone for Macquarie Pier on 5 August 1818 at 4 PM Her Excellency Professor Marie Bashir AC CVO Governor of New South Wales unveiled this plaque on the 4 August 2010 at 4 PM. The University of Newcastle's Coal River Working Party acknowledges that both events took place here at Muloobinba, within the traditional lands of the Awabakal people. Thanks to the Newcastle City Council, the Institution of Surveyors NSW Inc (Hunter Manning Group), Fort Scratchley Historical Society, Monteath & Powys Pty Ltd, NSW Land & Property Management Authority, Newcastle Port Corporation, Macquarie 2010 Committee and NSW Heritage Branch.
